scope: Public synthetic mathematical families and the fixed ISO-1 census; conjectures are separate from verified family labels.

entries.title: Union zeros lie in a 64p Hasse-boundary strip
entries.domain: Seven fixed complete p6 censuses, ordinary signed t=2 mod 4
entries.evidence: FALSIFIERS.tsv: 1184 violations; p7 trace +/-22 has gap 664 and limit 448.
entries.falsifier: One certified union-zero row outside the strip.
entries.next_experiment: No further confirmation runs; retain the counterexamples as controls.
entries.lean_status: Input-label truth retains parent native/PARI verification; aggregation lemmas checked separately.

entries.title: Subpolynomial corrections to linear growth of uncovered classes
entries.novelty: Exact class-uniform statement unresolved in bounded source audit
entries.domain: Primes p>3; ordinary signed t=2 mod 4 over F_(p^6); two named hyperelliptic branches
entries.statement: For every epsilon>0, Z(p)=O_epsilon(p^(1+epsilon)) as p tends to infinity over primes.
entries.evidence: REVIEW.tsv: seven exact census counts, not an asymptotic proof.
entries.falsifier: An unbounded prime sequence with a fixed superlinear exponent lower bound; a finite outlier only rejects a separately specified finite prediction.
entries.next_experiment: Retrospective extensions 53,59,61 have historical cubic artifacts; proposed prospective panel 71,73,79 has no matching filename in the inspected ISO-1 archive. Freeze before labels; finite forecast Z(p)<=24*p.
entries.lean_status: Open bound on exact finite class-support sets; count semantics mapped in PROOF_MAP.md.

entries.title: Selected CM mass and residual global obstruction
entries.novelty: Branch-conditioned occupancy study unresolved; CM mass is established
entries.domain: D_K<-4, fixed branch and sampling stratum, selected order conductors
entries.statement: Zero frequencies in preregistered bins of mu=M_B*H_B(t)/sum H_B approximately follow exp(-mu), with residual marked-CM orbit effects evaluated separately.
entries.evidence: Motivated by interior zero classes and local-filter failures; CM mass has not been evaluated in this addition.
entries.falsifier: Absolute zero-fraction calibration error greater than 1/5 in a preregistered unpooled bin with at least 30 held-out classes rejects the finite forecast; retain dependencies within each prime census.
entries.next_experiment: Freeze parameter occurrence law and selected CM masses on training primes before opening held-out labels.
entries.lean_status: Probability-model premise is unproved; algebraic definitions and exact support statements must be formalized separately.

entries.title: Non-hyperelliptic support outside both current branches
entries.novelty: Class-support difference unresolved; Type I/II covering geometries are published
entries.domain: The 46 exact p7 union-zero classes, published Type I/II genus-3 non-hyperelliptic coverings
entries.statement: At least one such class has a Type I or Type II non-hyperelliptic covering representative.
entries.evidence: Parent zero-class oracle complete; new covering certificates not yet produced.
entries.falsifier: A complete Type I/II support oracle is empty on all 46 classes; capped absence remains unresolved.
entries.next_experiment: Freeze all 46 evaluation classes; construct and independently certify covering geometry, field and isogeny condition.
entries.lean_status: Open actual-cover and Weil-restriction theorem; no conjecture axioms.

entries.title: Primitive simultaneous degree-two and degree-three tower coverings
entries.novelty: Primitive intersection unresolved; individual tower constructions are published
entries.domain: Ordinary E/F_(7^6), exact j degree six, no isogeny-class descent to a proper subfield
entries.statement: One E admits a genus-2 cover over F_(7^3) and a genus-3 cover over F_(7^2), each satisfying the corresponding Weil-restriction isogeny condition.
entries.falsifier: A complete empty intersection in the specified finite domain.
entries.next_experiment: Intersect declared published conditions on a frozen synthetic population and independently certify both covers and four descent degrees.
entries.lean_status: Open simultaneous geometric construction and class-descent bridge.

entries.title: Primitive higher-degree covers with smaller-genus quotient
entries.novelty: Special locus unresolved against general classifications
entries.domain: Relative degree n=5 or 7, q odd; primitive ordinary source; compositum genus 25 or 161
entries.statement: A primitive special locus has a base-defined quotient D with n<=g(D)<G_n and a surjective map J(D) to the full n-dimensional source Weil restriction.
entries.evidence: Existing higher-degree controls certify the original genus; no qualifying quotient established.
entries.falsifier: A global exclusion theorem; complete finite-subfamily absence rejects only that subfamily.
entries.next_experiment: Analyze rational quotient geometry and automorphisms in prescribed synthetic loci, rejecting subfield and class-descent controls.
entries.lean_status: Open geometric quotient, dimension and factor-survival proofs; elementary scaling screen remains a mapped field lemma.

entries.title: Exact j degree of primitive quadratic torus lifts
entries.novelty: Generalization of own degree-six result; broader prior implication unresolved
entries.domain: p>3, q=p^2, odd n>=3; lambda of exact absolute degree 4n in torus order (q^n+1)/(q+1)
entries.statement: Legendre j(lambda) has exact absolute degree 2n.
entries.evidence: Degree-six theorem and higher-degree controls are motivators; general universal theorem unproved here.
entries.falsifier: One parameter satisfying the full domain with a shorter j Frobenius period.
entries.next_experiment: Certify primitive lambda and all candidate j periods on frozen n=5,7 synthetic controls.
entries.lean_status: Open actual finite-field anharmonic-fibre and period proof, including exceptional cases.

entries.title: Polarization geometry beyond coarse arithmetic labels
entries.novelty: Conditioned profile unresolved; genus-3 isogenies are published
entries.domain: Prescribed p7 two-branch hyperelliptic covering models and rational maximal isotropic 2-kernels
entries.statement: Two coverings from different branches with the same Frobenius polynomial and 2-torsion Frobenius cycle type have different multisets of nonsingular polarized target types.
entries.falsifier: A complete profile oracle finding no such pair in the specified finite population.
entries.next_experiment: Freeze covering models and certify every mathematical kernel and target type; retain unknown classifications.
entries.lean_status: Open actual polarized-Jacobian and target-type proof.
